short_description: VR exposure therapy (VRET) platform for treating anxiety disorders, phobias, and PTSD through immersive 3D simulations controlled by mental health professionals
long_description: Psious is a behavioral health technology platform founded in 2013 in Spain that provides virtual reality exposure therapy (VRET) for mental health treatment. The Psious Toolsuite consists of a VR app and web-based control panel that allows clinicians to guide patients through immersive 3D simulations for treating phobias, anxiety disorders, and PTSD. The platform is hardware-agnostic and works with smartphones and 3D goggles without complex equipment investments. Designed by psychologists, Psious was built as a complementary tool to help clinicians manage exposure therapy challenges, providing a controlled environment between in-vivo and imaginal exposure. VRET has been validated by over 20 years of psychological research. Note: Psious was acquired by Amelia Virtual Care, which subsequently folded into XRHealth's platform.

faqs.a: Psious is a VR exposure therapy (VRET) platform that provides immersive 3D simulations for treating phobias, anxiety disorders, and PTSD. It was founded in Spain in 2013 and is designed for use by mental health professionals.
Psious was acquired by Amelia Virtual Care, which later folded into XRHealth. The technology continues as part of the XRHealth platform.

faqs.q: How much does VR exposure therapy software cost?
faqs.a: Therapeutic VR software licenses like Psious typically range from $1,500-4,000 per year, depending on the features and license type.

VR exposure therapy is effective for treating specific phobias (fear of flying, heights, spiders), social anxiety, PTSD, generalized anxiety disorder, and other conditions benefiting from controlled exposure.
